evidence: The Sn(dmamp)2 precursor was synthesized in the laboratory. The canister containing Sn(dmamp)2 was heated at 52 °C. The Sn precursor was delivered to the reactor with an Ar flow rate of 150 sccm. H2S (3.5%)/Ar gas mixture at a flow rate of 400 sccm was used as the S precursor. The feeding time of each precursor was varied to investigate the self-saturation behavior. The feeding times of Sn(dmamp)2 and H2S were both fixed at 2 s after verification of the saturation behavior. After examination of the purging time of precursor, the purging times of Sn(dmamp)2 and H2S were fixed at 10 and 20 s, respectively, to prevent intermixing of these precursors.
